name: Wadi Rum
oneLineFragment: Granite monolithic dusk and ochre ripples.
narrativeStory:
The desert here has no soft transitions. When the sun slips behind the monolithic sandstone massifs, the ambient temperature falls in minutes.

The iron sand glows maroon, then rust, then disappears into cold velvet black. Bedouin campfires whisper cedar and cardamon into the still evening sky.
subtitle: Valley of the Moon • Sandstone Massifs
introLines: Iron sand that shifts like liquid red dye.
Echoes between sheer cliffs of Jebel Rum.
